row: As a world-class academic and health care system, Duke Health strives to transform medicine and health locally and globally through innovative scientific research, rapid translation of breakthrough discoveries, educating future clinical and scientific leaders, advocating and practicing evidence-based medicine to improve community health, and leading efforts to eliminate health inequalities.

页面原文: If you have comments, suggestions or concerns about care provided at Duke Regional Hospital, we encourage you to discuss this with your provider, or with a clinic, hospital, or health system management. You may also call a patient advocate in our Patient and Visitor Relations department at 919-470-4747 or send an email.
HTML href: mailto:drhptadv@dm.duke.edu

页面原文: We strive to provide high-quality and safe patient care. If you have comments, suggestions or concerns about care provided at Duke University Hospital, we encourage you to discuss this with your provider, or with the clinic, hospital, or health system management. You may also call our patient relations department at 919-681-2020 or send an email. Our representatives are here to:
HTML href: mailto:patientvisitorrelations@dm.duke.edu
